rule: V7 is the single final destination. Preserve PAPER-only safety and the incumbent cutover dependencies until one exact V7 SHA has passed implementation/tests, same-SHA PAPER evidence, integration to main, paper-validated advancement, deployment and server health. Only then delete superseded V3-V6 runtime/config/workflow/monitoring surfaces. Do not create V8/V9/V10 or duplicate runtime, broker, ledger or scheduler ownership.

paper_v7_authorization.interpretation: 100% is a hard ceiling, not a target. Kelly, executable depth, authoritative fees, spread/slippage, joint completion, partial/unwind loss, adverse markout, capital/latency costs, state integrity and the 15% drawdown kill switch still bind.

architecture.target: one slim canonical V7 PAPER codebase
architecture.legacy_rule: Do not add new logic to V3/V4/V5/V6. Migrate any required primitive to V7/common with equivalent tests before deleting its legacy source. Git history is the archive.

economic_objective.multi_leg_rule: Estimate the empirical joint completion/state distribution; product or minimum of marginal fill probabilities is not an accepted substitute.
economic_objective.success: positive forward realized PAPER fill-conditioned post-cost PnL with causal data, simulated fills, authoritative fees, executable depth, partial/unwind losses, markout, cost stress and no leakage

model_contracts.fast_structural_arb: first economic frontier; use event-driven/local L2 state where possible, dual exchange/receive clocks, stale/sequence continuity checks, authoritative per-market fees, executable depth, sequential leg revalidation and explicit partial/unwind accounting
model_contracts.graph_rv: prospective dual-clock joint-state evidence only; queue ahead reduces fillability and must not grant capital; compare maker/maker, maker/taker, taker/maker, taker/taker, sequential, near-simultaneous, join, improve and cross by total executable EV; explicit partial-state unwind
model_contracts.cross_sectional_ranking: relative top-vs-bottom executable ranking; evaluate 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h and 6h separately; do not pool inference across horizons; frozen holdout model is fit once strictly before holdout_start minus embargo and is never refit inside the frozen holdout; online walk-forward evidence is separate
model_contracts.micro_taker: complete executable round-trip target with entry ask VWAP, expected/realized exit bid VWAP, both authoritative fees, slippage, uncertainty, adverse markout and capital-time costs; open positions mark to full-depth executable liquidation net of exit fee or fail closed
model_contracts.external_intelligence: run in parallel; inventory existing implementation and portfolio workspace read-only first; all features/probability mappings must be point-in-time; raw external features never become a synthetic terminal probability without approved causal mapping and evidence
model_contracts.learned_execution: estimate P(fill|X,a), fill-conditioned markout and multi-leg joint state distributions empirically for join/improve/fade/cross/size/timeout/cancel/replace and expose them to all strategies
model_contracts.micro_maker: selective incentive-aware maker only; optimize trading PnL and rewards separately; unconditional always-improve is not alpha; queue, OFI, imbalance, microprice, depth, toxicity, cancel latency and adverse markout are required
model_contracts.pca: single-leg residual statistical arbitrage only; evaluate 30m, 1h, 2h and 6h separately; no mandatory hedge basket, terminal-probability semantics or binary Kelly
model_contracts.local_factor: pair-specific panels, pair-excluded orientation-invariant factor basis, same-basis null-preserving inference, dependence-robust multiplicity, horizon-matched forecasts and explicit execution economics

rules: keep state, PnL, labels and inference separate by frequency
do not select a new frequency post hoc on the same holdout
new frequencies require prospective chronological evidence
frozen holdout evidence and adaptive walk-forward evidence must never be mixed

current_priority_order: Stop any destructive cleanup or operator-policy path that can delete cutover dependencies before same-SHA V7 deploy and server health.
Fast Structural Arb/HFT: maximize executable structural-arbitrage feedback with event-driven L2, strict dual-clock freshness, depth, fees, latency, partial/unwind and cost-stressed PAPER evidence.
Graph/RV execution: remove queue-coupled capital sizing, estimate empirical joint completion and optimize entry style by total executable EV.
Cross-sectional Ranking 15m: add the 15m horizon while keeping 15m/30m/1h/2h/6h separate and repair frozen-holdout refit leakage before interpreting OOS evidence.
Micro Taker: build selective short-horizon complete-round-trip execution after spread, fees, slippage and adverse move.
External Fair Value: continue point-in-time external data collection in parallel, reusing existing infrastructure and read-only portfolio data where provenance-safe.
Learned Execution: estimate fill, joint completion and fill-conditioned markout from the canonical execution ledger.
Selective Incentive-Aware Maker: use fill-conditioned net trading economics plus separately reported rewards; reject unconditional toxic improvement.
Market/regime specialization by category, liquidity, spread, TTR, event stage, volatility, information regime and fee regime.
PCA/Local Factor refinements only where forward evidence justifies them; statistics are filters, not PnL.
Keep one economically useful V7 Grafana and monitoring plane aligned to the deployed SHA.

After the exact V7 SHA is on main, paper-validated, deployed and server-health green, aggressively delete every superseded V3/V4/V5/V6 adapter, workflow, config, test, dashboard and transitional bridge no longer imported by V7/common.

scheduler_assignments.administrator-supervisor: Treat this V7 master directive as current authority; report collisions, mixed-SHA evidence, duplicate writers and any premature cleanup attempt.
scheduler_assignments.research-policy: Enforce V7-only new development, PAPER/authenticated separation, branch provenance, no duplicate ownership, same-SHA evidence and gated legacy retirement after V7 deploy/health.
scheduler_assignments.research-queue: Allocate work by the current priority order and avoid lanes already owned by another active agent/PR; move to the next independent lane when evidence is pending.
scheduler_assignments.promotion-controller: Promote only exact-provenance V7 integrations with required technical and economic evidence; do not treat CI or quoted edge alone as alpha.
scheduler_assignments.integration-merge: Remain the single canonical V7 integration writer; merge exactly one policy-compatible V7 integration after exact-head checks and never merge premature mass cleanup.
scheduler_assignments.control-plane-event-bridge: Dispatch only the existing Promotion Controller after validator completion and Integration Merge after a successful controller completion.
scheduler_assignments.post-merge-validation: Validate the exact merged SHA and require that the same revision is advanced through live-paper validation, paper-validated, deployment and health before cleanup unlocks.
scheduler_assignments.code-validation: Validate deterministic V7/common tests, operator-directive contracts, canonical ledger/runtime ownership and same-SHA deployment contracts without forcing new legacy development.
scheduler_assignments.monitoring-validation: Validate one canonical V7-oriented monitoring plane and per-strategy/frequency execution/PnL/data-health observability; do not accept stale Grafana as evidence.
scheduler_assignments.live-paper-validation: Run public-data PAPER validation of the exact candidate SHA; never weaken execution economics merely to create activity and never mix evidence across SHAs.
scheduler_assignments.paper-server-deploy: Deploy only the exact paper-validated V7 revision after the normal gate; do not deploy research branches or authenticated execution.
scheduler_assignments.paper-server-health: Verify deployed SHA, one runtime owner, one state writer, recorder/book freshness, ledger growth, fills/PnL/markouts, Grafana/exporter and scheduler health on the deployed V7 revision.
scheduler_assignments.forward-maker-research: Collect selective maker evidence only; preserve strict causal FIFO/cancel/depth/markout contracts and keep trading PnL separate from rewards.
scheduler_assignments.v6-live-data-research: Transitional evidence compatibility only until the same-SHA V7 cutover completes; do not add V6 logic. Retire this scheduler immediately after its last V7 dependency is migrated and deploy/health unlocks cleanup.
scheduler_assignments.alpha-factory: Select V7 challengers by forward/OOS executable economics, point-in-time causality, cost stress and reject/pass criteria; reject complexity without evidence.
scheduler_assignments.meta-supervisor: Coordinate V7-only research, single-writer surfaces and exact-SHA lifecycle; never reinterpret stale PR text as overriding this directive.
scheduler_assignments.fast-arb-shadow-research: Highest-priority research lane: collect read-only fast structural-arbitrage evidence with strict dual-clock freshness, continuity, executable depth, verified fees, legging/partial/unwind and latency accounting.
scheduler_assignments.arb-theory-research: Derive structural/Graph candidates and relation constraints under the V7 executable joint-state contract, without marginal-fill shortcuts or terminal-payout assumptions.
scheduler_assignments.external-intelligence: Collect and chronologically validate point-in-time public external information in parallel; reuse existing/portfolio data read-only where provenance-safe and keep probability mapping fail closed.
scheduler_assignments.live-api-smoke: Read-only Gamma/CLOB connectivity and freshness only; no model, policy, champion or execution mutation.
scheduler_assignments.v7-point-in-time-universe-archive: Maintain immutable V7 point-in-time universes for causal PCA/LF/ranking research; archive must not create a competing market-data fetch path.
scheduler_assignments.v7-unified-paper-evidence: Reconcile only exact-green V7 research heads into isolated per-SHA PAPER evidence; never merge/deploy, never pool evidence across code revisions, and never mutate main/paper-validated/champion.
scheduler_assignments.v7-cross-sectional-ranking-research: Repair frozen-holdout semantics first, then collect horizon-separated relative ranking evidence including the new 15m challenger; frozen and adaptive observers remain distinct and no live mutation is authorized.
scheduler_assignments.v6-market-cache-relay: Transitional cutover dependency only; do not expand V6. Preserve it only while V7 point-in-time/archive/runtime consumers still require its verified cache, then migrate the primitive to V7/common before gated retirement.

forbidden_regressions: Do not reopen or restore the obsolete V7 $125 fixed trade cap or 5%/15%/70% caps.
Do not create V8/V9/V10 or another numerical runtime generation.
Do not add new strategy/runtime logic to V3/V4/V5/V6; migrate useful primitives into V7/common before deletion.
Do not merge mass legacy deletion before one exact V7 SHA has completed tests, same-SHA PAPER, main, paper-validated, deploy and server-health convergence.
Do not add authenticated or real-money execution.
Do not create a second live state writer, broker owner, execution ledger, canonical integration or duplicated scheduler.
Do not call quoted edge, assumed fills, in-sample Sharpe or CI success profitable alpha.
Do not use product/minimum of marginal fill probabilities as a generic multi-leg joint completion estimator.
Do not mix frozen-holdout evidence with adaptive refits or pool ranking/PCA evidence across horizons.
Do not write scheduler-generated code or artifacts outside authorized repository/runtime/evidence paths; the portfolio workspace is read-only by default.
